title: 龙卷风 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel drawing with thick waxy strokes and smudged blending, storm grey, olive green and warm ochre

pages.scene: One single tornado, a tall twisting column of grey air hanging from a dark cloud base down to the ground, wide at the top and narrow at the bottom. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single dark storm cloud with a low flat rotating base underneath it and a broad flat top. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
One single red wooden barn with a pitched roof standing on flat ground. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
One single wooden spinning top standing upright and spinning on its point. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.
